CS3005 Topic 7 - AI in Games

NPCs in Games

  • In the past, game AI was simple and was there to oppose players.
  • Nowadays, AI is able to generate believable actions through the use of NPCs.

Creating a Good NPC

1) Correct Action Definitions

  • We do not want NPCs to be 'damaged' by bugs, so to speak
  • This can affect the sense of immersion and realism.
  • E.g. ChatGPT speech seems great for NPCs, but comes with risk.

2) Right Level of Challenge

  • If an NPC is too stupid the player will feel bored and unchallenged.
  • If an NPC is too skilled the player may feel cheated.

3) Right Level of Predictability

  • If an NPC is too predictable, it makes it easier for players to "game" the NPC.
  • If an NPC is too unpredictable, it may damage the sense of immersion and realism.

4) Variety

  • Types of NPC / AI need to stand out from each other.

Goals of Game AI

  • We want the game AI to be fun, even if this means dumbing down the AI's intelligence level.

    • We want the player to come back.

  • NPCs should provide challenge, but not be overwhelming.

  • We must make sure the AI is unable to cheat.

  • We also do not want an AI to consume lots and lots of CPU/Memory.

    • 30% CPU time is typically used by game AI.

3 Basic Game Roles for AI

  • Acting as a replacement for human opponents and players.
  • Acting as support characters for interesting player interactions
  • Acting as units for player management.

  • For example, if an NPC were to cheat, this is okay as long as the player cannot detect it.
  • Variable levels of skills are essential.
  • Play to lose - or at least make it challengng.

There is no single type of AI that works for all games or AI roles.

AI Engine Execution Flow

Sense

  • The sense element refers to AIs analysing the surrounding.
  • We need to define what the AI should be looking out for

Think

  • The meat of the AI. This will involve a decision-making process, which can utilise any of the technologies listed above.
  • The individual technologies used will depend on the complexity of the game and its AI.

History of AI

  • Game AI stretches as far back as PAC-MAN and Super Mario.
  • In PAC-MAN, each ghost has their own pathfinding AI that is dependent on the player's position
  • Super Mario makes use of scripted AI, meaning various units in the game will follow scripted patterns.
  • This could include moving back and forth
